## 抓取原文

Before writing code, build a governance cell.

Use a RACI matrix to clarify ownership:

Model risk teams demand validation plans, privacy officers audit every prompt, and auditors expect immutable logs.

Regulated deployments succeed when AI and risk teams co-own the lifecycle.

Takeaway: Governance is pre-approved trust; invest early so launches do not get vetoed late.

Run tabletop exercises quarterly with compliance, legal, ops, and engineering.
